name: Nassau Glass Co Ltd
tier_visual_why: Thickness and tint are the two choices a glass customer cannot picture from a photo, and a laminated build-up is invisible in one. A single lightweight real-time sheet (no transmission pass, two box plies and an interlayer) shows both, and feeds the quote.
primary_cta: Quote this glass (builds a summary, then Call (242) 603-5521)
brand_truth: The Bahamas' first fabricating glass company, still cutting glass from 1/16 to 3/4 of an inch at #46 Mackey Street, where it started in 1959.
buyer: Nassau homeowners and landlords replacing or fitting glass, mirrors and showers; contractors and facility managers needing storefronts, laminated safety glass and repairs. Phone first, then the counter.

direction.lane: P01 Limestone (sea glass field, the green of their own building)
direction.type: T03 Swiss grotesk (Instrument Sans only, 400 and 600)
direction.why: A glass panel is the archetype's own example; the object is their stock, and the green field makes glass readable and matches their building.

concept_type: brochure: departments + stock picker + quote summary
big_idea: The first screen is a sheet of Nassau Glass's own stock: pick glass, mirror or laminated, any thickness and tint they list, and scrolling pulls laminated safety glass apart into its two sheets and interlayer.

images.credit: Nassau Glass, the building on Mackey Street (400x234 source, shown at or under native size)
Still rendered from this site's own 3D sheet of glass, used as the canvas poster

current_site_findings: 'SASTIFIED CLIENTS' is misspelled in large letters on the homepage.
The real stock list is buried in one paragraph on an inner page.
Most photos are stock; the six real shower enclosures and the green building are small or absent.
No homepage meta description; the title is only 'Nassau Glass Company'.
The services carousel shows the same six departments twice.
A 'business for sale' notice sits beside the phone numbers on every page.
pitch_line: Your customers call to ask what thickness and tint you have. This concept lets them see it, pick it and read you a ready summary, on a phone, in a minute.
assumptions: Thickness steps between 1/16 and 3/4 in (1/8, 1/4, 3/8, 1/2) are standard fractions inside their stated range; confirm the exact stocked list.
Mirror colour 'flesh tone' and all tint swatches are rendered approximations; confirm against real samples.
The laminated explanation (two sheets, a bonded interlayer that holds broken pieces) is the general definition of laminated glass, not their wording; confirm.
The 3D sheet is drawn as a small sample, labelled 'a rendered sample'.
No email or WhatsApp is published, so the quote ends in a call and a copyable summary; in production it would post to their existing contact form.
The for-sale notice on their site is left out of the concept on purpose.
Shower photo alt texts describe what is visible (frameless, sliding); the frame type of each install is not captioned by them.
